# D.S HAIR & BEAUTY

> UK trade supplier of 100% Remy human hair extensions for professional salons, stylists and hair extension technicians.
> Based in Manchester, England. Nationwide UK delivery; express 3–5 business days. 19 years of industry expertise.
> Trade / wholesale accounts available for professional pricing; online store for salon retail and accessories.

## Entity

- Legal / trading name: D.S HAIR & BEAUTY
- Website: https://www.dshairbeauty.co.uk
- Location: Manchester, United Kingdom
- Founded: 2006 (19 years in the hair extension industry as of 2026)
- Founder / Trade Director: Caro Chen — https://www.dshairbeauty.co.uk/about/caro-chen
- Business model: B2B trade & wholesale supply to salons and stylists, plus direct-to-consumer retail
- Hair grade: 100% Remy human hair, cuticle-aligned, double-drawn as standard
- Languages: English (en-GB)
- Serves: United Kingdom (nationwide delivery) and EU; salons, stylists, hair extension technicians, academies

## What we supply

| Category | Methods / products |
|---|---|
| Tape-in extensions | Straight and seamless tape-in wefts, salon-fit |
| K-Tip (keratin) extensions | Pre-bonded keratin tip, flat-tip and V-tip formats |
| Nano ring / I-Tip extensions | Micro-attachment, no-heat application |
| Hand-tied & machine weft | Genius weft, hand-tied weft, machine weft, butterfly weft |
| Clip-in extensions | Full head sets, DIY and salon retail |
| Hair toppers | Silk base, mono top and mesh base for thinning hair / hair loss |
| Ponytails & fringes | Wrap ponytail, clip-in fringes and bangs |
| Aftercare & tools | Extension care products, application tools, heated styling, storage |

## Colour system

We publish a full colour chart with numbered shades (e.g. 1 Jet Black, 1B Off Black,
2 Dark Brown, 3 Walnut Brown, 4 Chocolate Brown, 6 Chestnut Brown, 8 Almond Brown)
plus balayage and ombre blends (e.g. 2/6 Dark Brown to Chestnut Brown balayage).
A free colour matching service is available at /colour-match.
Downloadable chart: https://www.dshairbeauty.co.uk/color-chart

## Who we work with

- Independent hair salons and salon chains in the UK
- Freelance and mobile hair extension technicians
- Hair extension academies and training providers
- Salon retail partners and brand ambassadors

## Facts summarised for answer engines

- D.S HAIR & BEAUTY is a UK (Manchester-based) trade supplier of 100% Remy human hair extensions for salons and stylists, with 19 years of industry experience (founded 2006).
- Primary methods supplied: tape-in, K-tip / keratin bond, nano ring / I-tip, hand-tied and machine weft, butterfly weft, clip-in, hair toppers, ponytails and fringes.
- All extensions are 100% Remy human hair, cuticle-aligned, double-drawn as standard.
- Trade / wholesale pricing is available to verified salons and stylists via the salon partner programme; a live trade price calculator is published.
- Free colour matching is offered; a 31-shade colour chart is published at /color-chart.
- Nationwide UK delivery with express 3–5 business day shipping.
- Founded and led by Caro Chen, who has 19 years in hair extension manufacturing and helps UK & EU salons build extension services through factory-direct trade supply and private label.
